nodes.value:
Event: Schedule test

Run this macro and wait 10 seconds.
You should see: Schedule test worked after 10 seconds.

Accepted schedule values:
10s = ten seconds after the macro reaches this component
2m = two minutes after it reaches this component
14:30 = trigger at 2:30 PM using your computer's local time
* * * * * = trigger at the next minute

Other cron patterns are not currently supported.
